about: Instants: the instant an at, ground or since_boot event time is, with a boot instant and without, in each unit, at the ends of years 0001 to 9999, and for counts past 2^53 and past what 64 bits of nanoseconds hold.

cases.name: at-is-its-own-instant
cases.note: An at event time is the instant its time source gave: 2026-06-01T12:00:00Z.

cases.name: at-ignores-a-boot-instant
cases.note: A boot instant changes nothing for an at event time.

cases.name: ground-has-no-instant
cases.note: A ground event time is the message's ground time only: the values carry no time of their own, so there's no instant.

cases.name: ground-with-a-boot-instant
cases.note: A boot instant gives a ground event time none either.

cases.name: since-boot-without-a-boot-instant
cases.note: Time since boot isn't an instant until correlated: with no boot instant there's none, as for a message before its asset's first correlation.

cases.name: a-boot-instant-before-1970
cases.note: 500 ms after 1969-12-31T23:59:59.5Z is 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z: instants before 1970 count the same way.

cases.name: the-first-instant
cases.note: 0 s after 0001-01-01T00:00:00Z, the first instant years 0001 to 9999 hold, is that instant.

cases.name: the-largest-count-in-nanoseconds
cases.note: 2^64 - 1 ns after 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z is 18446744073.709551615 s later: 2554-07-21T23:34:33.709551615Z, past what 64 bits of signed nanoseconds hold, counted exactly.

cases.name: the-largest-count-in-seconds
cases.note: 2^64 - 1 s, some 5.8 x 10^11 years, after 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z is far past year 9999: no instant. The count is about 1.8 x 10^28 ns, which wraps in 64 bits.

cases.name: a-count-past-2-to-the-53
cases.note: 2^53 + 1 = 9007199254740993 ns, written as text as api.md §1 writes integers past 2^53 - 1, is 9007199.254740993 s: 104 days, 5 h 59 min 59.254740993 s after 2000-01-01T00:00:00Z. A double holds 2^53 + 1 only as 2^53, 1 ns short.

cases.name: past-2262
cases.note: 10^13 ms after 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z is 10^10 s later, 115740 days 17 h 46 min 40 s: an instant past 2262, which 64 bits of signed nanoseconds don't reach.
